live_planning_issue_refs.required_parent_action: Create or read back one additional live Planning issue for Task 5 Planning follow-up acceptance, then attach the issue id and readback source in the final L3 audit.

stop_conditions.stop_condition: Stop after the gap index has one owner, one artifact path and one validation command for every L3 gap.
Stop after every rubric row has an allowed output type, a forbidden-output check and a human-review trigger.
Stop after the action board contains ten rows and no row contains a vague action phrase.
Stop after each capability has a workflow proof requirement and one explicit non-counting evidence example.
Stop after every memory row has authority set to candidate_only or a no_write_reason that names the approval blocker.
Stop after the table marks production routing as blocked unless Governance has a later accepted decision artifact.
Stop after the checklist can be verified without exposing credentials, private sessions or unaccepted production claims.
Stop after Labebe has a resume trigger and no Task 5 action writes Labebe production code.
Stop after every runtime row has an allowed-use value and no quarantined provider is assigned production work.
Stop after the handoff lists every remaining action with a concrete owner, artifact path and stop condition.
